rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a card, document, or offer becomes invalid after its date.

example.english: The membership card will expire soon.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 wui2 jyun4 kaat1 zau6 faai3 gwo3 kei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this everyday verb for a person or animal dying, though a more polite expression may be chosen in respectful contexts.

example.english: That old dog is about to expire.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 lou5 gau2 zau6 lei4 sei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a period, event, or process comes to an end rather than when an item becomes invalid.

example.english: The trial period will expire at the end of the month.
example.traditional: 個試用期去到月底就結束喇。
example.jyutping: go3 si3 jung6 kei4 heoi3 dou3 jyut6 dai2 zau6 git3 cuk1 laa3
